start.text: (A voice through the darshini's back window.) Who's there? — Uncle sent you? Two of them at my counter since Tuesday. I can't reach the back door with them listening.

choices.text: Throw stones at the van up the road.

saved.text: (Stones on tin. The two at the counter turn their heads, then their bodies. A window opens.)

left.text: (Quiet from the window. Then: 'Tell Uncle I'm alright.')
